$comment: Recorded human decisions for the browser style and quality gates (validate:contrast-browser,
typography-browser, responsive, console-clean, axe-lessons). Read by tools/lib/lesson-gate-kit.mjs.
An entry turns ONE finding class from a failure into a reviewed, reported exception:
"decidedBy": "<a person>", "reason": "<40+ characters: why this is acceptable>" }
Rules, enforced by the gate: reason under 40 characters FAILS; a missing decidedBy FAILS; an entry whose
finding no longer fires FAILS on a full sweep (delete it) so this file cannot become stale absolutions.
Do not add an entry to make a gate pass: fix the page, or take the decision to Joel first.
Same shape as data/game-rules-review.json and the other *-review.json ratchets.
